body_html:
How to think about it

India has many festivals. Harvest festivals such as Pongal in Tamil Nadu, Onam in Kerala, Bihu in Assam and Baisakhi in Punjab give thanks for good crops. People decorate homes, draw rangolis, cook special food and share it with friends.

National festivals belong to all of us: Republic Day on 26 January, Independence Day on 15 August and Gandhi Jayanti on 2 October. We can celebrate without harming nature by using clay lamps and natural colours and avoiding loud crackers and plastic.

Example

Onam is celebrated mainly in…

snake boat races

Answer: Kerala

Example

Republic Day date?

the Constitution began

Answer: 26 January

Common mistakes

  • Mixing up Independence Day and Republic Day.
  • Thinking only one festival is celebrated in India.
  • Forgetting the environment during celebrations.
